name: Cinder Crown
intent: A fast canyon crossing, an elevated explosive-loop landmark, then a broad final trick jump.

stages.name: Cinder rollers
stages.role: Learn weight transfer and build downhill momentum

stages.name: Quarry crossing
stages.role: First commitment; long visible catch; checkpoint after settling

stages.name: Crown approach
stages.role: Climb to the landmark and normalize entry speed

stages.name: The crown
stages.role: Optional explosive connector and loop; safe ground fallback

stages.name: Pumping straight
stages.role: Two low rollers introduce final launch rhythm

stages.name: Last light
stages.role: High arc, broad catch, post-gap checkpoint and generous runout

stages.name: Finish boulevard
stages.role: Unobstructed finish; no surprise barrel or final trap

validation: Geometry and point-mass sweep only; actual bike torque, wheel contact, suspension and trigger timing need Unity playtest.
